name: Brass: Birmingham

categories.label: Canal and rail links
categories.help: Points from your links at the end of each era (1 per linked-location icon); enter one value per era.

categories.label: Flipped industries
categories.help: Points shown on your flipped industry tiles at the end of each era; enter one value per era.

categories.label: Income level
categories.help: Your income level when the game ends (may be negative); the highest wins a tie.

categories.label: Money left
categories.help: Pounds remaining at the end of the game; the most breaks a further tie.

notes: Two eras (canal, then rail): enter the canal era value first, then rail. Read from the publisher-hosted PDF. If still tied after income and money the rulebook says the players draw, recorded here as a shared win. The shorter introductory game with extra scoring, and the Lancashire game, are excluded. Player count 2 to 4 comes from the rulebook setup rules for 2, 3 and 4 players.
